ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 221,600 Dental hygienists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 237,200 by 2034. That represents about 15,600 additional jobs, with roughly 15,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $94,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dental hygienists, but it will accelerate image review and records. Imaging AI and electronic records speed preliminary assessment and data entry. Hygienists shift toward hands-on scaling, patient education, and preventive care plans. Record-only work faces pressure, while clinicians with precise technique and clear education skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated preliminary review of intraoral scans and images
Automated entry of periodontal probing data
Automated delivery of patient education materials
ai_s3_list: Hands-on scaling: people provide gentle precision.
Patient communication: people address concerns.
On-site judgment: people assess abnormalities.
Patient education: people guide lasting habits.
Comfort-focused care: people shape the experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Dental hygienists in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate image review and records, while people still provide scaling, education, and clinical judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Systems replace preliminary image review and record entry, not the role of scaling and patient education. Hygienists with steady technique and strong communication become scarcer as clinics improve efficiency. Record-only work faces the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build dental hygiene fundamentals and practice both clinical technique and image review. Record-only work is shrinking, so develop scaling skills early.
Advance from recording data toward prevention + patient education. Learn periodontics and work toward team leadership.
Highlight clinical technique and patient complaint cases. List the clinics and procedures you supported. Employers value steady, gentle care.
Do not assess candidates on credentials alone. Evaluate steady, atraumatic technique. Hygienists who educate patients merit higher incentive pay.

ai_s7_trends: Imaging AI increases efficiency and reduces record work.
Rising preventive awareness strengthens demand.
Hygienists with steady technique and clear education skills become harder to find.

body: Dental hygienists provide preventive and basic periodontal services under a dentist's supervision. Their work includes scaling, periodontal probing, fluoride application, imaging support, and oral hygiene education.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能读片标出龋和骨吸收，但龈下那块结石怎么刮干净、患者为什么不敢刷，还是卫生师的眼和手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年口腔卫生师在岗约 22.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.72 万人，净增约 1.56 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.53 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代口腔卫生师，但会加速判读与记录。影像 AI 和电子病历把初判与录入提速，卫生师从「写记录」挪向「手上洁治、患者教育、预防方案」。真正被挤掉的是纯记录与初判，手法轻准、会宣教的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 手上洁治：轻准靠人。
患者沟通：顾虑靠人解。
现场判断：异常靠人定。
宣教引导：习惯靠人带。
舒适照护：体验靠人给。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的判读区——读片与记录被系统加速，但手法与教育还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「影像初判与记录」动作，不是「洁治宣教」的岗位。手法稳、会沟通的卫生师，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会记数据的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 口腔卫生打底，在校多练手法和影像。AI 时代纯记录在缩，早点练洁治。
从「记数据」升级成「做预防 + 宣教」，学牙周专科，争取当组长。
突出手法与客诉案例，写清跟过哪些诊所。诊所看重稳和轻。
选人别只看证，要看手稳不会伤。能宣教的卫生师，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 影像 AI 提效，记录缩。
预防意识升，需求旺。
手法稳会宣教的更缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can tune process settings quickly and accurately, but experienced workers alone recognize when an older machine sounds wrong or a material batch will fail as soon as it enters the line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 66,000 metal and plastic machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 66,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with about 6,500 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $47,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not fully replace Extruding And Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic. Die changes, machine setup, troubleshooting, and quality judgments require hands-on experience and action at the machine. AI can take over parameter monitoring and routine records, but skilled workers still bring a machine to its best operating state.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of digital control systems
Robotic arms replace material loading and unloading
ai_s2_auto: Automated monitoring and recording of process parameters
ai_s3_list: Machine-setting feel: experience balancing process parameters.
Die assessment: identify wear and assembly problems.
Troubleshooting: analyze shutdowns on the spot.
Quality judgment: spot product defects at a glance.
Equipment maintenance: recognize conditions by sound and appearance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Automation handles parameter monitoring and records, while AI vision begins to inspect quality. Skilled workers still control machine setup, die changes, and troubleshooting, which require practical judgment and experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not guarantee safety. Automation is reducing jobs that only watch machines. Operators need to develop into process technicians who read data, adjust systems, and resolve complex faults. Those skills provide protection from robotic and AI replacement.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students with limited formal education can study CNC machining or electromechanical technology and enter a factory as apprentices. Workshops can be hot and noisy, but machine setup is a marketable skill. Advancing toward process technician or team leader is stronger than remaining in basic operation.

Master the principles behind process parameters and digital control systems. They are the key to advancing from operator to technician. Join new-equipment commissioning and process-improvement projects so practical experience becomes documented technical knowledge.

People with mechanical or electromechanical backgrounds adapt quickly. In interviews, emphasize hands-on skill, quality awareness, and reliability. Factories value workers who stay, so stability itself is an advantage.

Do not hire only people who can start a machine. Develop employees who understand the process. Use skill-based pay and advancement paths to retain experienced workers. Capture setup knowledge through mentoring and process documentation.

ai_s7_trends: Digital controls and AI vision inspection expand, reducing machine-watching roles.
Process-skilled operators become essential to factories.
Workshop automation creates new equipment-maintenance roles.

body: Extruding And Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic set up and run forming equipment. They turn metal or plastic raw materials into pipes, profiles, bars, and wire while adjusting parameters, monitoring processes, and inspecting quality.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 6.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.68 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.65 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会完全取代挤出机操作工：换模、调机、异常处理和质量判断都需要实际经验和临场操作，设备再智能也要有人到现场处理。AI 能接管参数监控和常规记录，但「把机器调到最佳状态」这件事，机器还替不了熟练工。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉检测产品质量
机械手替代上下料作业
ai_s2_auto: 工艺参数自动监控与记录
产量与质量数据自动统计
设备状态数据实时采集
ai_s3_list: 调机手感：参数配合的经验判断。
模具判断：磨损与装配问题识别。
异常处置：停机排查的临场分析。
质量眼光：一眼看出产品缺陷。
设备维护：听声看况的老经验。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明操作工处于「AI 明显介入、核心靠人」的位置：参数监控和记录被自动化接管，AI 视觉开始检测质量，但调机、换模、异常处理这些需要手感与经验的环节，依然是熟练工的地盘。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低中分不等于安全：自动化升级在压缩纯看机岗位，操作工要往「工艺技术员」方向走——学会读数据、调系统、处理复杂异常，才不会被机械手和 AI 替代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历一般的孩子可以先学数控、机电类专业，进厂从学徒做起。要讲清楚：车间环境热、噪音大，但学会调机是实打实的技术，往工艺员和班组长走比纯操作强得多。
把工艺参数和数字化控制系统的原理学透，这是你从操作工升级技术员的钥匙。多参与新设备调试和工艺改进项目，让经验变成能写进方案的东西。
有机械、机电背景的转这行上手快。面试时突出动手能力、质量意识和稳定性——工厂最怕招了干几天就走的，稳定本身就是优势。
别只招「会开机的人」，要培养「懂工艺的人」。用技能等级工资和晋升通道留住老师傅，让他们的调机经验通过师徒制和工艺文档沉淀下来。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化控制与 AI 视觉检测普及，纯看机岗位收缩。
工艺技术型操作工成为工厂刚需。
车间自动化升级带动设备运维新岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace infantry officers, but it will take over planning, intelligence compilation and training data. Commanding and making decisions, leading team training, and leading troops to educate people are the core responsibilities of humans and cannot be replaced by machines.
ai_s2_accel: Simulated confrontation system improves training efficiency
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted drafting of action plans and documents
Automatic organization and analysis of intelligence data
Training data and results are automatically recorded
Digitization of equipment and material ledgers
ai_s3_list: Making decisions on the fly: The battlefield situation changes rapidly, and it depends on the officer's judgment and responsibility.
Leading soldiers and educating people: The training, thinking, and growth of soldiers must be brought out bit by bit by officers.
Lead by example: Only when an officer shouts "Follow me" will the soldiers obey you.
Training organization: Designing courses well and controlling risks is a management knowledge.
Willpower and resistance to pressure: Stabilizing the team under high-intensity tasks is the result of long-term hard work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 shows that the proportion of documents, data, and intelligence compilation in this profession is not high, and these are being assisted by the system; the core command, leadership, and decision-making are highly dependent on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean unchanged. Informatization and intelligent equipment are changing the style of combat - officers must be able to command and use intelligent systems. Those who are really squeezed are the cadres who can only lead troops in the traditional way and cannot keep up with the information transformation; officers who understand command information systems and can use unmanned equipment are more valued.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you want to go to a military academy or directly recruit officers, your political and physical conditions must be passable, and your cultural scores must be strong. In the AI ​​era, military academies must have a solid grasp of the application of command information systems and intelligent equipment, not just physical fitness.

Actively learn the use of command information systems and unmanned equipment, and combine traditional troop leadership with information-based command. Pay attention to the relocation policy and plan in advance the capacity reserves for military-civilian connection.

Positions in the military can be entered through formal channels such as military schools, direct recruitment of officers or recruitment of soldiers, and there are no side doors. After retirement, it is advantageous to combine military management, emergency safety, project management and other skills to transition to civilian positions.

When retired military personnel transfer to enterprises, priority is given to positions with strong discipline and high stress resistance (project management, safety, emergency response). The experience of an officer brings with it the ability to command and coordinate. Don’t just look at whether the major is the right one.

ai_s7_trends: The informatization and integration construction of the army is accelerating, and the command quality requirements of officers have been upgraded.
With the popularization of drones and intelligent equipment, military officers need to master the coordinated command of humans and machines.
Training has been transformed into scientific and technological training, and officers who understand the application of information systems and data are more valued.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代步兵军官，但会接管计划拟制、情报整理和训练数据。指挥决断、带队训练和带兵育人，是人的核心职责，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 指挥信息系统辅助决策
无人机侦察辅助态势感知
智能化装备训练与运用
模拟对抗系统提升训练效能
ai_s2_auto: 行动计划与文书 AI 辅助拟制
情报数据自动整理分析
训练数据与成绩自动记录
ai_s3_list: 临机决断：战场情况瞬息万变，靠的是军官的判断与担当。
带兵育人：士兵的训练、思想、成长，要靠军官一点一滴带出来。
以身作则：军官喊「跟我上」，士兵才会服你。
训练组织：把课目设计好、把风险控住，是门管理学问。
意志与抗压：高强度任务下稳住队伍，是长期磨出来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的文书、数据、情报整理比重不高，这些正被系统辅助；核心的指挥、带兵与决断高度依赖人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不变。信息化和智能化装备在改变作战样式——军官要会指挥、更要会用智能系统。真正被挤压的是只会传统带兵、跟不上信息化转型的干部；懂指挥信息系统、会运用无人装备的军官更受重视。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走军校或直招军官路径，政治身体条件要过关，文化成绩要硬。AI 时代军校要把指挥信息系统、智能化装备运用学扎实，别只练体能。
主动学指挥信息系统与无人装备运用，把传统带兵和信息化指挥结合起来。留意转业安置政策，提前规划军地衔接的能力储备。
军内岗位从军校、直招军官或士兵提干等正规渠道进入，没有旁门。退役后结合军事管理、应急安全、项目管理等技能，衔接民用岗位有优势。
退役军人转入企业，优先放在纪律性强、抗压性高的岗位（项目管理、安全、应急）。军官的经历自带指挥与统筹能力，别只看专业是否对口。

ai_s7_trends: 部队信息化与合成化建设加快，军官指挥素养要求升级。
无人机与智能化装备普及，军官需掌握人机协同指挥。
训练向科技练兵转型，懂信息系统与数据运用的军官更受重视。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: The factory can prefabricate standard pipe sections, but people still have to climb up and wrap up the crooked elbow.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 27,200 mechanical insulator workers on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 28,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 1,300 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 2,300, and a median annual salary of approximately US$57,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mechanical insulators, but it will take over standard section prefabrication. The cutting software and factory prefabrication wrap the straight pipe section first, and the workers' time shifts from "wrapping standard sections" to "on-site measurement, special-shaped wrapping, and high-altitude operations." Those who are really squeezed out are those who only do the standard section. Those who can climb high and cover abnormal shapes are more stable.
ai_s3_list: On-site measurement: Dimensions depend on human measurement.
Special-shaped package: the elbow is wrapped by someone.
Working at heights: safety depends on people.
Sealing and closing: the fit depends on human inspection.
Responsibility: The installation site is responsible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 shows that this profession is in a medium-high exposure area - the standard section is prefabricated, but on-site measurement and special-shaped packages still mainly rely on people, and the position is overall stable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: However, medium and high exposure does not mean no risk: what is accelerated is the "standard section", not the "position". Those who can measure on site and wrap special shapes are more stable, while those who only work on standard sections will be picked up by prefabrication.

ai_s5_persona.建议: As a foundation for secondary vocational education, I practiced cutting and climbing a lot in school. The standard segment in the AI ​​​​era is shrinking. Practice aliens and on-site as early as possible, and don’t just take direct control.
Upgrade from "Standard Section" to "Measurement + Alien + High Altitude", learn to read pictures and data, and strive to become the team leader.
Highlight on-site and climbing experience, and write down what equipment you have packed. Prefabrication experience is preferred.
Recruiting people should not only be based on willingness to work, but also based on measurement and specialization. People who can climb high and bend well deserve a high salary.

ai_s7_trends: Prefabrication is popularized and standard sections are outsourced.
Field measurement and anomalies form core competencies.
People who can climb higher are more stable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械绝缘工在岗约 2.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.85 万人，净增约 0.13 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机械绝缘工，但会接手标准段预制。下料软件与工厂预制把直管段先包好，工人的时间从「包标准段」挪向「现场测量、异形包裹与高空作业」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准段的人，能爬高能包异形的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 现场测量：尺寸靠人量。
异形包裹：弯头靠人包。
高空作业：安全靠人担。
密封收口：贴合靠人查。
责任归属：安装现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——标准段被预制，但现场测量与异形包裹仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于无风险：被加速的是「标准段」，不是「岗位」。会现场测量、能包异形的人更稳，纯做标准段的人会被预制接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中职打底，在校多练下料与登高。AI 时代标准段在缩，早点练异形和现场，别只包直管。
从「包标准段」升级成「测量 + 异形 + 高空」，学看图和数据，争取往班组长走。
突出现场与登高经历，写清包过哪些设备。有预制经验优先。
招人别只看肯干，要看测量和异形。能爬高包弯头的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 预制化普及，标准段外包。
现场测量与异形成核心能力。
能登高的人更稳。

body: 机械绝缘工按图纸对机械、管道与设备进行保温、保冷与防护包裹，现场测量、下料、安装与密封，保障能效、安全与人防烫，是工程安装与运维一线的技能角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 工厂能预制标准管段，但那个歪弯头还得人爬上去包。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Parametric tools can automate layouts and renderings, but landscape architects still decide what a site needs, which plants fit, and what the client actually wants.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 21,800 landscape architects employed in 2024, projected to reach 22,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 800 jobs, with roughly 1,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $79,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace landscape architects, but it will reduce early-stage hours. Parametric and generative tools accelerate routine layouts and renderings, shifting architects from producing large volumes of drawings toward site judgment, ecological planning, implementation coordination, and design leadership. Standard-detail drafting is most exposed, while site and ecological experience becomes more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Site judgment: people identify the real problems.
Ecological planning: people balance competing needs.
Customer communication: people uncover needs.
Design leadership: people make tradeoffs.
On-site implementation: people oversee quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation at moderate AI exposure: early-stage drafting becomes faster, while human judgment and communication remain essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces standard drafting tasks, not responsibility for understanding a site and delivering the built result. Greater productivity makes people with site and ecological experience more valuable; repetitive drafting specialists face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong software and planting skills from an environmental design or landscape background. Pure drafting is shrinking in the AI era, so develop site and ecological experience early.
Advance from detailed drafting to design leadership and site work. Learn ecology and construction, then pursue project responsibility.
Emphasize your portfolio and built projects, clearly identifying the types of sites you have worked on.
Do not hire on software skill alone. Look for site judgment; people who can turn plans into built work merit stronger project incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Parametric tools become widespread, reducing early-stage hours.
Ecological design and sponge-city projects create opportunities.
People with site experience become more sought after.

body: Landscape architects plan and design outdoor spaces, coordinating landform, vegetation, paving, drainage, and circulation while balancing ecology, function, and appearance to create useful, enduring built environments.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Parametric tools can automate layouts and renderings, but landscape architects still decide what a site needs, which plants fit, and what the client actually wants.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 参数化能自动排布和出图，但场地有什么问题、植物怎么配、甲方要什么，还是景观师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年景观建筑师在岗约 2.18 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.26 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代景观建筑师，但会压缩初段工时。参数化与生成式工具把常规排布和效果图提速，景观师从「画大量图」挪向「判断场地、把握生态、沟通落地、做主创」。真正被挤掉的是只画标准详图的人，有现场和生态经验的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 场地判断：问题靠人看。
生态把握：平衡靠人。
客户沟通：需求靠人挖。
主创决策：取舍靠人。
现场落地：质量靠人盯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——初段绘图被加速，但判断与沟通还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「画标准图」动作，不是「把控场地与落地」的岗位。有现场和生态经验的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做重复绘图的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 园林/环艺起步多练软件和植物，AI 时代纯画图在缩，早点练现场与生态。
从「画详图」升级成「做主创 + 走现场」，学生态与施工，争取项目负责。
突出作品集和落地项目，写清跟过哪些类型场地。
选人别只看软件，要看有没有现场判断。能落地方案的人值得给高分成。

ai_s7_trends: 参数化普及，初段工时缩。
生态与海绵城市带来机会。
有现场经验的人更抢手。

body: 景观建筑师规划并设计户外空间，统筹地形、植被、铺装、排水与动线，兼顾生态、功能与美观，使建成环境可用且耐看。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 参数化能自动排布和出图，但场地有什么问题、植物怎么配、甲方要什么，还是景观师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI screen readers can describe an entire world, but learning how to leave home with a white cane still takes step-by-step practice with a rehabilitation specialist.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 160,000 specialist therapists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 182,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,100 jobs, with around 10,200 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $98,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Low Vision Therapists, Orientation And Mobility Specialists, And Vision Rehabilitation Therapists. Instead, it will become a valuable assistant. Smart screen readers, AI visual aids, and navigation tools are changing how people with visual impairments live, shifting specialists' work toward "teaching people to use AI + practicing physical skills." Machines cannot replace the human interaction involved in assessment, training, and ongoing support.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of AI screen readers and smart visual-assistance devices
AI navigation and route narration that support mobility training
Remote video rehabilitation that expands service coverage
Upgrades to smart vision aids, magnification tools, and recognition tools
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of vision-assessment reports and rehabilitation plans
Digitizing teaching materials and training records
Digitizing case databases and assessment scales
ai_s3_list: In-person assessment: observing difficulties and potential in real-world settings.
Instructional breakdown: turning daily living skills into steps that can be practiced.
Orientation and mobility training: on-site practice in routes, judgment, and confidence.
Psychological support: rebuilding confidence and learning to accept and move beyond vision loss.
Cross-organization coordination: connecting support across the client's home, school, and community.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates that AI is assisting with assessment records and teaching materials, but the core of rehabilitation remains "training and support." AI is a new tool for people with visual impairments, while specialists teach them to use those tools and rebuild their lives, so replacement potential is limited.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: There is no need to panic about moderate AI exposure. The more AI-powered assistive devices become available, the greater the need for trained rehabilitation specialists who can teach their use, adapt them to individual needs, and help clients practice combining them with physical skills. Integrating smart assistive devices into instruction is an important way for these specialists to expand the value of their services and increase their income.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Vision rehabilitation offers scarce talent, strong demand, and meaningful work. It suits students with genuine patience and empathy. Rehabilitation therapy, special education, and optometry all provide entry routes, followed by specialized certification in orientation and mobility.

Integrate smart screen readers, AI visual assistance, and remote rehabilitation tools into everyday instruction, and expand home-based services and independent practice. Pursue advanced certifications to progress toward supervision or instructor roles.

People with backgrounds in rehabilitation, special education, or social work generally transition smoothly into this field. Complete specialized training and certification first, then enter through a rehabilitation organization or school for blind students. In interviews, highlighting clients you have served and their rehabilitation outcomes is more persuasive than listing certificates.

Vision rehabilitation professionals are scarce. Provide systematic training and certification support to improve retention, and give home-service staff adequate travel coverage and psychological support to prevent excessive front-line burnout.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Voice narration of text and images
Core tools for orientation and mobility

ai_s7_trends: As AI screen readers and visual-assistance devices become widespread, rehabilitation instruction is shifting from "a single skill" to a combination of "AI + physical skills."
Population aging is increasing demand for vision rehabilitation, while the shortage of qualified professionals continues to widen.
Remote rehabilitation and home-based service models are expanding, creating broader service areas and more varied ways to practice.

body: Low Vision Therapists, Orientation And Mobility Specialists, And Vision Rehabilitation Therapists provide functional vision assessments, training in the use of vision aids, instruction in daily living skills, and orientation and mobility training for people with low vision or visual impairments, helping them participate in society safely and independently.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI screen readers can describe an entire world, but learning how to leave home with a white cane still takes step-by-step practice with a rehabilitation specialist.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 读屏能念出整个世界，但「怎么用一根白杖走出家门」，还是得康复专家陪着一步步练。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年专家治疗师在岗约 16.00 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.21 万人，净增约 2.21 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代视力康复专家，反而会成为得力助手：智能读屏、AI 视觉辅助、导航工具改变了视障者的生活方式，专家的工作变成「教人用 AI + 练身体技能」。评估、训练、陪伴这些人与人互动的环节，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 读屏与智能视觉辅助设备普及
AI 导航与路线播报辅助出行训练
远程视频康复扩展服务半径
智能助视器具与放大识别工具更新
ai_s2_auto: 视力评估报告与康复计划自动生成
教学资料与训练记录电子化
案例数据库与评估量表数字化
预约与随访管理自动化
ai_s3_list: 面对面评估：观察真实场景中的困难与潜能。
教学拆解：把生活技能拆成可练的步骤。
定向行走训练：路线、判断、安全感的现场陪练。
心理支持：重建自信，接纳并超越失明。
跨机构协调：帮患者在家庭、学校、社区之间接上支持。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明评估记录与教学资料正被 AI 辅助，但康复的核心是「训练与陪伴」，AI 是视障者手里的新工具，专家是教他们用工具、重建生活的人，替代度有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不必慌：AI 辅助器具越多，越需要专业的康复专家教人用、做适配、练配合。把智能辅助设备纳入教学，是视力康复专家扩大服务价值和收入的重要方向。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 视力康复是「人才少、需求大、有意义」的方向，适合真心有耐心和同理心的孩子。康复治疗、特教、视光专业都可以作为入口，再补定向行走专项认证。
把智能读屏、AI 视觉辅助和远程康复工具纳入日常教学，拓展上门服务和自主执业；考取更高级别认证，往督导、培训师方向发展。
有康复、特教、社工背景的转此方向较顺；先完成专项培训与认证，从康复机构或盲校岗位切入。面试时突出你服务过的个案与康复效果，比证书更打动招聘方。
视力康复人才稀缺，建议提供系统培训与认证支持来留人；给上门服务配好差旅保障和心理支持，避免一线人员过度损耗。

ai_s7_trends: AI 读屏与视觉辅助设备普及，康复教学从「单一技能」转向「AI + 身体技能」组合。
老龄化推高视力康复需求，专业人才缺口持续扩大。
远程康复与上门服务模式扩展，服务半径和执业方式更多元。

body: 视力康复专家为低视力与视障人士提供视觉功能评估、助视器具使用训练、日常生活技能指导与定向行走训练，帮助他们安全、独立地参与社会生活。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 读屏能念出整个世界，但「怎么用一根白杖走出家门」，还是得康复专家陪着一步步练。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can add annotations and produce drawings with one click, but technicians still have to visit the workshop to determine whether a tolerance will assemble correctly and why a prototype keeps cracking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 38,300 mechanical engineering technologists and technicians employed in 2024, projected to remain at 38,300 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 0 jobs, with roughly 3,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $68,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is reshaping mechanical technicians' work. Automatic CAD annotation, generative design, and simulation assistance are absorbing traditional drawing, table-lookup, and calculation tasks. Technicians will not disappear, but roles are shifting toward people who use tools, understand processes, and work on site. AI produces drawings quickly, but people still resolve parts that do not assemble or pass tests.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic CAD annotation and drawing production
Automated standard-part selection and table lookup
ai_s3_list: Field judgment: resolve deviations between drawings and actual assemblies.
Test analysis: identify mechanisms behind abnormal data.
Process experience: make practical tradeoffs among materials, tolerances, and machining.
Cross-department coordination: connect design, manufacturing, and quality.
Hands-on ability: assemble and debug prototypes skillfully.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score identifies mechanical technicians as a medium-to-high-exposure technical occupation. AI rapidly takes over rules-based work such as drawing, annotation, and component selection, clearly reducing the value of traditional technician skills. At the same time, AI can double technician output, increasing demand for people who use it well. This is a role undergoing wholesale skill renewal.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure is both a warning and an opportunity. Master AI drawing and simulation tools while strengthening process and on-site skills. Moving from drafter to a combined process + testing technician creates a stronger position during the AI transition.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mechanical majors remain viable, but choose industries carefully. High-growth sectors such as new-energy vehicles, semiconductor equipment, and aerospace need technicians. Build strong CAD, simulation, and programming fundamentals in school, spend time in practical workshops, and learn AI tools quickly to become more competitive at graduation.

Stop depending on drawing skills alone. Learn simulation analysis, understand manufacturing processes, and work on site, with deeper development in testing and process roles. At the same time, master AI drawing tools and shift from drawing quickly toward judging accurately and implementing reliably.

If you have a mechanical background and want a technician role, first complete your CAD and measurement-tool skills. In applications, emphasize experience turning drawings into physical products, including structures you modified and assembly problems you solved. This is more persuasive than listing software.

Do not hire only people who can draw. Hire versatile technicians who understand implementation and use AI tools. Provide suitable software and simulation environments and create a technician -> engineer advancement path. This retains core staff more effectively than repeated hiring.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Reverse engineering and comparison of physical products

ai_s7_trends: Pure drafting technician roles contract, and AI tools become standard.
High-growth manufacturing industries drive demand for versatile technicians.
Technicians transition toward process, testing, and simulation roles.

body: Mechanical engineering technologists and technicians support product development and manufacturing under mechanical engineers, including CAD modeling and drafting, prototype assembly and testing, data acquisition and analysis, process-document preparation, and on-site technical coordination.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can add annotations and produce drawings with one click, but technicians still have to visit the workshop to determine whether a tolerance will assemble correctly and why a prototype keeps cracking.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动标注、一键出图，但「这个公差现场装不装得上、样件为什么老是裂」——这些落地问题，还得技师下车间找答案。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械工程技师与技术员在岗约 3.83 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.83 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在重塑机械技师的工作：CAD 自动标注、生成式设计、仿真辅助正在吃掉「画图、查表、算数」这些传统活。技师不会失业，但岗位在向「会工具、懂工艺、能上现场」转型——AI 出图快，但现场装不上、测不过的坑，还是得人填。
ai_s2_accel: 生成式设计与拓扑优化
工艺 AI 推荐与排程
ai_s2_auto: 标准件选型查表自动化
图纸版本与 BOM 管理数字化
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：图纸与实际装配的偏差处理。
测试分析：异常数据背后的机理判断。
工艺经验：材料、公差、加工的实际权衡。
跨部门协调：设计、制造、质量的沟通。
动手能力：样件装配与调试的手上功夫。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明机械技师是「中高曝光」的技术岗位：画图、标注、选型这类规则明确的活正被 AI 快速接管，传统技师技能缩水明显；但同时 AI 也让技师的产出效率翻倍，会用的技师在职场更吃香，属于「技能换血」型岗位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是警钟也是机会：把 AI 制图、仿真工具用到熟练，同时强化工艺和现场能力，从「画图员」升级成「工艺 + 测试复合技师」，就能在 AI 浪潮里拿到更好位置。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选机械专业仍可行，但要盯着产业走：新能源汽车、半导体设备、航空这些高景气行业缺技师；在校把 CAD、仿真、编程基础打牢，多去实训车间，AI 工具学得越快，毕业越抢手。
停止「只会画图」的路径依赖：学仿真分析、懂加工工艺、能上现场，往测试和工艺方向深耕；同时把 AI 制图工具用熟，从「画图快」转向「判断准、落地稳」。
有机械背景想转技师岗，先补齐 CAD 和测量工具技能；求职时重点展示「图纸到实物的落地经验」（改过什么结构、解决过什么装配问题），比罗列软件更打动面试官。
别只招「会画图的」，招「懂落地、会用 AI 工具」的复合技师：配好软件和仿真环境，给技师设计「技术员 → 工程师」的晋升通道，比反复招人更能留住骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 纯画图技师岗位收缩，AI 工具成标配。
高景气制造行业拉动复合技师需求。
技师向工艺、测试、仿真方向转型。

body: 机械工程技师与技术员在机械工程师的指导下开展产品开发与制造的技术支持，包括 CAD 建模制图、样件装配与测试、数据采集分析、工艺文件编制和现场技术协调。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule appointments and enter records automatically, but it cannot help an older patient with limited mobility walk to the examination room.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 811,000 Medical Assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 912,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 101,200 jobs, with around 112,300 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $44,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Medical Assistants as a whole, but it will absorb substantial administrative work. Self-service systems and AI are taking over scheduling, record entry, report organization, and payment guidance. Patient reception, clinical assistance, and on-site response remain human responsibilities.
ai_s2_accel: AI triage recommends departments by symptom
ai_s2_auto: Self-service registration, payment, and online appointments
AI medical-record entry and voice transcription
Automatic filing and organization of test reports
ai_s3_list: Patient reception and communication: AI cannot reassure and explain things to anxious patients and families.
Clinical assistance: measuring vital signs, preparing instruments, and assisting physicians require precision.
On-site response: emergencies, queue disputes, and urgent additions require human handling.
Privacy and safety: medical-record confidentiality depends on human judgment behind policies.
Workflow coordination: people connect physicians, technicians, and patients.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means administration and documentation account for a substantial share of the job and are being absorbed by AI and self-service systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk, provided workers move beyond miscellaneous administration. As AI handles registration and entry, value shifts toward clinical assistance and patient service. System-only assistants face replacement, while clinically skilled workers gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Medical assisting offers fast entry, but workers must build their own ceiling. Study nursing or medical assisting, pursue credentials such as CMA early, and learn clinical skills during internships. Front-desk skills alone have limited value in the AI era.
Master AI registration and record systems, then use saved time to develop clinical assistance and patient service. Advance toward specialty assistance, nursing, or healthcare management.

This is a strong entry point into healthcare. Service or administrative backgrounds transfer quickly, but workers must learn clinical skills and earn credentials. List procedures assisted with and clinic workflows independently managed.
When hiring, assess patient communication and clinical assistance, not only system use. Assistants who understand workflows, reassure patients, and learn clinical skills deserve growth opportunities.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Appointments, queue calls, and record routing

ai_s7_trends: Registration and entry become self-service and AI-driven, shifting Medical Assistants from administration toward clinical assistance and patient service.
Primary care and outpatient expansion increases demand for assistants with clinical skills and patient communication.
Improved certification and training systems remove system-only assistants and create premiums for combined skills.

body: Medical Assistants handle appointments, records, and patient reception while helping physicians with basic examinations, instrument preparation, and procedures, connecting patients, clinicians, and administrative workflows.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule appointments and enter records automatically, but it cannot help an older patient with limited mobility walk to the examination room.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动挂好号、录好病历，但那位腿脚不便的老人需要有人扶着去诊室时，AI 帮不了忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医疗助理在岗约 81.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 91.22 万人，净增约 10.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 11.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.42 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医疗助理整体岗位，但会抢走大量行政活。预约挂号、病历录入、报告整理、缴费指引，这些正被自助系统和 AI 快速接管。剩下的患者接待、临床辅助、现场应变，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 分诊辅助按症状推荐科室
智能排班与患者通知系统
电子病历的数据结构化
远程问诊平台的预约与随访
ai_s2_auto: 自助挂号缴费与在线预约系统
AI 病历录入与语音转写
检查报告自动归档与整理
医保与保险信息的自动核验
ai_s3_list: 患者接待与沟通：面对焦虑的患者和家属，安抚和解释是 AI 做不到的。
临床辅助操作：测体征、准备器械、配合医生，手上的活儿要准。
现场应变：突发状况、患者插队纠纷、急诊插单，现场要能兜住。
隐私与安全：病历保密、患者隐私，制度背后是人的判断。
流程协调：医生、技师、患者之间的事，靠人来回串联。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的行政与记录比重较高，这些正被 AI 和自助系统大量接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险——前提是别只做「行政打杂」。AI 把挂号录入做掉后，医疗助理的价值必须转向临床辅助与患者服务；只会操作系统的助理确实有被替代的风险，懂临床的反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医疗助理入门快但天花板要自己建。建议学护理或医疗助理专业，尽早考 CMA 等认证，实习时多学临床技能；AI 时代，只会前台操作的路走不远。
把 AI 挂号录入系统用熟，省下的时间练临床辅助和患者服务。往专科助理、护理或医疗管理方向走，别停留在「行政打杂」。
这是进入医疗行业的好跳板。有服务、行政背景者可快速上手，但一定要边做边学临床技能，考取证书，简历里多写「协助过XX类操作、独立管理过门诊流程」。
招医疗助理别只看能操作系统的，要看患者沟通和临床协助能力。懂流程、会安抚患者、愿意学临床技能的助理，值得给成长空间。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 语音转写与结构化录入
复诊提醒与满意度回访
多渠道预约与排队管理

ai_s7_trends: 挂号录入全面自助化与 AI 化，医疗助理从行政转向临床辅助与患者服务。
基层医疗与门诊扩张，懂临床技能、会患者沟通的复合型助理需求增长。
认证与培训体系完善，只会操作系统的助理被出清，技能复合者溢价明显。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically record parameters and send material-change reminders, but operators still decide whether to add water or powder when viscosity is wrong and whether to stop a machine when it makes an unusual noise.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 101,100 machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 94,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 6,800 jobs, with roughly 8,800 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $47,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace machine operators, but it will change how they work. Systems are taking over automated material feeding, parameter logs, and output statistics, shifting operators from manual recordkeeping to monitoring, judgment, and emergency response. Machines cannot replace on-site judgment about unusual equipment noise, quality fluctuations, or minor formula adjustments. Operators who understand both equipment and data will have greater job stability.
ai_s3_list: Equipment anomaly assessment: experience is needed to recognize unusual noise, vibration, and pressure fluctuations.
Hands-on quality judgment and experience: people assess viscosity and uniformity that machines cannot fully measure.
Fine-tuning formulas: people make on-site corrections for differences between material batches.
Emergency response: people handle blockages, spills, and shutdowns on the spot.
Safety and procedural compliance: people uphold the rules in high-risk workshops.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates that repetitive recordkeeping is being automated. Systems now handle material feeding, parameters, and output data, while people remain responsible for on-site monitoring and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still means meaningful change. The more automated a factory becomes, the more it needs operators who understand the system and can resolve anomalies. Purely manual roles are declining, while operators with maintenance and process knowledge are in greater demand.

ai_s5_persona.建议: You can enter the field without extensive education, but vocational study in electromechanics, chemical processing, or food processing provides a stronger start. Learn equipment principles and production processes rather than stopping at knowing which buttons to press.

Become proficient with automated control systems and testing instruments, then advance toward equipment maintenance or team leadership. Progressing from operation to operation + maintenance + process expertise is key to withstanding automation.

Factory or equipment experience is ideal, but newcomers can start as operator apprentices. On your resume, specify the equipment you have operated, the anomalies you have handled, and the procedures and standards you know.

When hiring operators, assess more than obedience. Look for responsibility and the ability to handle anomalies. In an automated workshop, employees who can spot problems and are willing to stop the machine and report them are more valuable than those who only know how to operate it.

ai_s7_trends: As automated controls spread, operators shift from manual operation to system monitoring and anomaly response.
As predictive maintenance and online testing mature, operators who understand equipment and can interpret data become more sought after.
Growth in flexible production and small-batch customization leads to more frequent formula adjustments, raising the value of experienced operators.

body: Mixing and blending machine setters, operators, and tenders set up and operate mixing and blending equipment in food, chemical, building-material, and other industries. They follow formulas to load materials, set parameters, monitor processes, collect samples, test quality, and record output.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automatically record parameters and send material-change reminders, but operators still decide whether to add water or powder when viscosity is wrong and whether to stop a machine when it makes an unusual noise.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动记录参数、提醒换料，但黏度不对时是加水还是加粉、设备异响时该不该停机，还得操作员拿主意。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 10.11 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.43 万人，岗位净减约 0.68 万个，年均产生约 0.88 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代机器操作员，但会改变操作方式。自动投料、参数记录、产量统计正被系统接管，操作员从「手动记录」转向「监控、判断、应急」。设备异响、质量波动、配方微调这些现场判断，机器替代不了——懂设备又会看数据的操作员反而更稳。
ai_s3_list: 设备异常判断：异响、震动、压力波动，靠经验识别。
质量的手感与经验：黏度、均匀度，机器测不到的全靠人。
配方微调：材料批次差异，靠人现场补正。
应急处理：堵料、溢料、停机，当场处置靠人。
安全与规范执行：高危车间，守规矩靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的重复记录环节正被自动化——投料、参数、产量都有系统代劳，但现场监控和判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。自动化程度越高的工厂，越需要「看得懂系统、处置得了异常」的操作员。纯手动岗在减少，会维护、懂工艺的操作员反而更抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历不高也能入行，但建议读技校机电、化工、食品加工相关专业，起点更高。把设备原理和工艺知识学起来，别只满足于会按按钮。
把自动控制系统和检测仪表用熟，往设备维护、班组长方向走。从「操作」升级为「操作+维护+工艺」，是抗自动化冲击的关键。
有工厂或设备经验最好，无经验可从操作学徒切入。简历上多写「操作过哪些设备、处理过哪些异常、熟悉哪些流程规范」。
招操作员别只要求听话，要看责任心和处理异常的能力。自动化车间里，能发现问题、敢停机上报的人比会操作的人更值钱。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化控制普及，操作员从「手动操作」转向「系统监控与异常处置」。
预测性维护与在线检测成熟，懂设备、会看数据的操作员更抢手。
柔性生产与小批量定制增多，配方调整更频繁，经验型操作员价值上升。

body: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在食品、化工、建材等行业设置并操作混合与搅拌设备，按配方完成投料、参数设定、过程监控、取样检测和产量记录。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动记录参数、提醒换料，但黏度不对时是加水还是加粉、设备异响时该不该停机，还得操作员拿主意。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Nurse Midwives, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 8,600 nurse midwives were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 9,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 900 jobs, with roughly 500 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $128,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nurse midwives, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creative problem-solving. Routine execution that follows instructions mechanically will lose ground, while professionals who understand real-world conditions and make sound decisions will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate patient or learner assessment in nurse midwifery.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate care-plan testing in nurse midwifery.
Use retrieval tools to verify information and regulations for nurse midwifery.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in nurse midwifery.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for nurse-midwifery work.
Process and classify repetitive data in nurse midwifery.
Perform rules-based initial screening and scheduling for nurse-midwifery services.
Search nurse-midwifery knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real-world nurse-midwifery settings.
The ability to explain nurse-midwifery expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in nurse midwifery.
Cross-functional resource integration and interpersonal coordination in nurse midwifery.
Applying tacit knowledge built through long-term nurse-midwifery experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist nurse midwives, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in an exposure score of 6/10.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 6/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: First build a strong foundation in nurse midwifery and gain real-world experience.
Connect your existing experience to nurse midwifery and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn nurse-midwifery experience into scalable products or management systems to increase its impact.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive nurse-midwifery work and focus on decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Draft copy and plans for nurse-midwifery work

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between nurse midwives and AI becomes standard, making tool proficiency a baseline requirement.
Second, high-value judgment and accountability in nurse midwifery become scarcer.
Third, nurse-midwife roles evolve toward combinations of professional expertise and management or product skills.

body: Nurse midwives care for mothers and babies throughout pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum recovery. They attend births, monitor patients, and provide health guidance, serving as guardians of low-risk maternity care.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Nurse Midwives, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉护士助产士的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年护士助产士在岗约 0.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.95 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代护士助产士，但会重塑Nurse Midwives的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Nurse Midwives的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Nurse Midwives的方案推演。
用检索增强Nurse Midwives的资料与法规查证。
用协作工具加速Nurse Midwives的跨团队协同。
ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Nurse Midwives相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Nurse Midwives的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Nurse Midwives初步筛查与排程。
Nurse Midwives知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Nurse Midwives场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Nurse Midwives专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Nurse Midwives领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Nurse Midwives资源整合与人际协调。
Nurse Midwives长期经验的隐性知识复用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分逻辑：Nurse Midwives可被 AI 辅助，但「专业判断」与「责任终审」难替代，故6/10 曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 6/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Nurse Midwives基础打牢，积累真实项目。
用既有经验对接Nurse Midwives，找差异化切口。
把Nurse Midwives经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放Nurse Midwives重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_s7_trends: 一是Nurse Midwives与 AI 协同成为常态，工具素养成门槛。
二是Nurse Midwives的高价值判断与责任环节更稀缺。
三是Nurse Midwives岗位向「专业 + 管理/产品」复合演进。

body: 助产护士（Nurse Midwives）在孕期、分娩与产后全程照护母婴，接生、监测、做健康指导，是低风险的守门人。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能吞掉护士助产士的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can enter orders automatically, but clerks still decide which call matters, which form needs follow-up, and whose request takes priority.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 2,646,000 general office clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 2,468,200 by 2034, a net loss of about 177,800 jobs, with roughly 282,400 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $43,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace office clerks, but it will reduce standard roles. Automated entry and electronic filing accelerate routine paperwork, shifting clerks from entering forms toward coordination, exception handling, and interpersonal communication. Roles limited to data entry will lose ground, while people who coordinate become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Coordination: people keep miscellaneous work moving.
Interpersonal communication: people handle reception.
Exception handling: people resolve bottlenecks.
Priority judgment: people distinguish urgency and importance.
Trust and accountability: people catch and correct errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure area for clerical work. Systems accelerate standard paperwork, while people remain essential for coordination and communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Data entry is being replaced, not roles that coordinate operations. Organized people who take responsibility become scarcer as efficiency rises. Clerks limited to order entry face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start by mastering office software. Pure order-entry work is shrinking in the AI era, so build coordination skills early.
Progress from order entry to managing registers + coordination. Learn system operations and aim to own one category of business.
Emphasize attention to detail and office-software skills, and clearly describe the types of administrative work you have supported.
Do not hire based only on typing speed. Assess organization and interpersonal awareness.

ai_s7_trends: Automated entry and filing.
Stable demand for coordination roles.
Clerks who understand systems become more sought after.

body: Office clerks coordinate an organization's routine documents and communications, handling entry, filing, contacts, and reconciliation and using office systems to keep administration running smoothly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can enter orders automatically, but clerks still decide which call matters, which form needs follow-up, and whose request takes priority.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动录单，但哪通电话要紧、哪份单子要催、谁的事要优先，还是文员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年办公室文员、普通在岗约 264.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 246.82 万人，岗位净减约 17.78 万个，年均产生约 28.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代办公室文员，但会压缩标准岗。自动录入与电子归档把常规文书活儿提速，文员从「录单子」挪向「协调对接、异常处理、人际往来」。真正被挤掉的是只做纯录入的，会协调的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 协调对接：杂事靠人顺。
人际往来：接待靠人。
异常处理：卡点靠人。
优先判断：轻重靠人。
信任兜底：差错靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文员区——标准文书被系统加速，但协调与对接还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「纯录入」动作，不是「协调运转」的岗位。有协调力、能兜底的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做录单的文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从办公软件练起，AI 时代纯录单在缩，早点练协调。
从录单升级成管台账 + 对接，学系统操作，争取管一类业务。
突出细心和办公软件，写清跟过哪些类事务。
选人别只看打字，要看有没有条理和会来事。

ai_s7_trends: 录入归档自动化。
协调岗需求稳。
懂系统的文员更抢手。

body: 办公室文员统筹单位的日常文书与往来，处理录入、归档、接洽与对账，运用办公系统保障行政运转顺畅。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动录单，但哪通电话要紧、哪份单子要催、谁的事要优先，还是文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can interpret seismic data and forecast production extremely quickly, but engineers still decide whether a well is worth drilling and how to control its risks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 19,600 petroleum engineers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 19,800, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 1,200 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $141,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace petroleum engineers, but it will redesign analytical workflows. With AI handling seismic interpretation, reservoir modeling, and history matching, engineers shift from running simulations toward setting development strategies, managing field risks, and making cross-disciplinary tradeoffs. What remains truly scarce is the ability to integrate geology, engineering, and economics into one practical plan.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted optimization of well locations and trajectories
Smart recommendations for fracturing and stimulation plans
Real-time production optimization through digital-twin oilfields
Smart alerts and scenario simulation for geological risks
ai_s2_auto: Smart interpretation of seismic data and well logs
Automatic history matching for numerical reservoir models
Automatic fitting of production forecasts and decline curves
Automatic monitoring and alerts for drilling parameters and conditions
ai_s3_list: Field decisions: people resolve complex downhole conditions.
Engineering tradeoffs: experience balances cost, safety, and production.
Cross-disciplinary coordination: integrate geology, drilling, and surface facilities into a plan.
Economic judgment: integrated assessment determines whether a project is worthwhile.
Final accountability: signing means accepting responsibility, which machines cannot replace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates moderately high exposure in modeling and analysis. Interpretation, fitting, and forecasting are accelerated, but people retain responsibility for field judgment and solution tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Running data and adjusting parameters are being replaced, not roles that set development strategies. People who make cross-disciplinary tradeoffs and manage complex field conditions become scarcer. Engineers who only click through simulation software and avoid fieldwork are vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in petroleum engineering/oil and gas storage and transportation, and study some geology and programming at school. The AI era rewards both modeling and fieldwork, not memorizing formulas alone.
Expand from single-discipline analysis to full-chain development, study data science and economics, master AI tools, and advance into a development expert who sets plans.
Highlight the blocks you have worked on, stimulation projects you completed, and complex wells you handled. Overseas and unconventional experience is preferred.
Hire for cross-disciplinary tradeoffs and field experience, not simulation proficiency alone. Engineers who independently manage blocks deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Digital twins and AI optimization enable more precise production gains from existing oilfields.
Unconventional gas and overseas projects support demand as traditional expansion contracts.
Hybrid engineers who understand data and work in the field are in greater demand.

body: Petroleum engineers evaluate oil and gas reservoirs, design drilling and completion operations, develop stimulation measures, and optimize production. They use geology, fluid mechanics, and simulation tools to improve recovery, serving as core specialists connecting underground resources with output.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把地震解释和产量预测算得飞快，但「这口井值不值得打、风险怎么控」，还得工程师拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年石油工程师在岗约 1.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.98 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 14.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代石油工程师，但会重做分析流程。地震解释、储层建模、历史拟合交给 AI 后，工程师从「跑模拟」挪向「定开发策略、管现场风险、做跨专业权衡」。真正稀缺的是能把地质、工程和经济拧成一套可落地方案的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助井位与井轨迹优化
压裂与增产方案的智能推荐
数字孪生油田的实时生产优化
地质风险的智能提示与情景模拟
ai_s2_auto: 地震数据与测井曲线的智能解释
储层数值模型的自动历史拟合
产量预测与递减曲线的自动拟合
钻井参数与工况的自动监控告警
ai_s3_list: 现场决策：井下复杂情况要人定夺。
工程权衡：成本、安全、产量的取舍靠经验。
跨专业协调：把地质、钻井、地面串成方案。
经济判断：项目值不值得上，靠综合评估。
责任兜底：签字即担责，机器不能替。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的建模分析区——解释、拟合、预测都能被加速，但现场判断和方案权衡仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑数据和调参数」，不是「定开发策略」。会做跨专业权衡、能管现场复杂情况的人更稀缺。怕的是只会点模拟软件、不蹲现场的工程师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 石油工程/油气储运打底，在校把地质和编程都学点。AI 时代拼的是建模和现场，别只背公式。
从单科分析扩到全链条开发，学数据科学和经济学，把 AI 工具用熟，升级成能定方案的开发专家。
突出你跟过哪些区块、做过什么增产、处理过什么复杂井。有海外和非常规经验优先。
招人看跨专业权衡和现场经验，不止看模拟熟练度。能独立负责区块的工程师值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 数字孪生与 AI 优化让存量油田增产更精细。
非常规气与海外项目支撑需求，传统增量收缩。
懂数据、能下现场的复合工程师更抢手。

body: 石油工程师负责油气藏评价、钻井与完井工程设计、增产措施与生产优化，运用地质、流体力学与模拟工具提升油气采收率，是连接地下资源与产量的核心技术岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically generate training plans and follow-up reminders, but only the person coaching beside the patient notices when their expression looks wrong after a set of exercises.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 111,500 physical therapist assistants and aides were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 136,000, a net increase of about 24,500 jobs, with about 19,800 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $65,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace physical therapist assistants. Rehabilitation training is close, hands-on work, and patients need real encouragement, physical support, and correction that machines and chatbots cannot provide. AI can take over training records, scheduling, follow-up reminders, and plan documentation, freeing assistants from desk work to spend time with patients.
ai_s2_accel: Remote rehabilitation guidance expands service reach
ai_s2_auto: Digital training records and plan documentation
Automated organization of rehabilitation progress data
ai_s3_list: Close coaching: support with hands, encourage with words, and observe with eyes.
Condition observation: use expressions and exertion to judge whether intensity is appropriate.
Safety protection: prevent secondary injury during transfers and walking.
Psychological support: give discouraged patients the courage to complete one more set.
Clinical bridge: accurately report patient changes to the therapist.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that the process layer of physical therapy assistance is becoming digital. Systems take over records, scheduling, and follow-up, while rehabilitation remains physical interaction between people. AI cannot soon replace coaching, care, observation, or encouragement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure encourages advancement. Use digital record tools effectively while pursuing credentials as a rehabilitation therapist. AI removes documentation, not the skill of helping a patient stand again.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Rehabilitation has clear demand and moderate entry barriers and suits hardworking people who want to serve others. Study rehabilitation therapy technology and earn credentials early. Plan the path from assistant to therapist instead of stopping at the assistant level.

Plan credential advancement immediately. Moving from assistant to rehabilitation therapist is the key to doubling income. Also learn specialties such as sports and neurological rehabilitation and use digital follow-up tools to expand service reach.

People with nursing, sports, or fitness backgrounds have transition advantages. Build foundational rehabilitation knowledge and earn relevant assistant credentials, highlighting real experience coaching others, patience, and physical fitness in interviews.

Assistant turnover is high. Retain staff with certification subsidies + flexible scheduling + advancement pathways. Provide digital record tools to reduce workload and focus training investment on strong employees advancing toward therapist roles.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Parameter control for electrotherapy, ultrasound, and related treatments

ai_s7_trends: Population aging and sports rehabilitation demand continue expanding rehabilitation services.
As digital records and remote rehabilitation spread, assistants shift from documentation toward direct service.
Combined coaching + specialty + digital skills determine the career ceiling.

body: Physical therapist assistants and aides execute rehabilitation plans under physical therapists, helping patients complete exercise training, use equipment, and receive physical modalities while maintaining records, follow-up, and daily care as execution and support roles in rehabilitation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动生成训练计划和随访提醒，但「患者今天做完这组动作表情不对」——这个细节，只有蹲在旁边带练的人看得见。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物理治疗助理与助手在岗约 11.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.60 万人，净增约 2.45 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.98 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.55 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代物理治疗助理：康复训练是贴身的手工活，患者需要真实的鼓励、扶助和纠正，机器和聊天机器人给不了。AI 能接管的是训练记录、预约排班、随访提醒、方案文书，把助理从案头活里解放出来，让时间真正花在患者身上。
ai_s2_accel: 可穿戴设备监测训练效果
康复机器人辅助运动训练
远程康复指导扩展服务半径
AI 辅助评估训练完成度
ai_s2_auto: 训练记录与方案文书电子化
预约排班与随访提醒自动化
康复进度数据自动整理
理疗设备参数自动记录
ai_s3_list: 贴身带练：用手扶、用嘴哄、用眼看。
状态观察：从表情和发力判断训练强度合不合适。
安全防护：转移和行走保护不让患者二次受伤。
心理支持：患者沮丧时给「再来一组」的勇气。
医患桥梁：把患者变化准确反馈给治疗师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明物理治疗助理的「流程层」正在被数字化：记录、排班、随访都被系统接管。但康复训练的本质是「人与人的身体互动」，带练、照护、观察、鼓励这些核心动作，AI 短期内无法替代。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中位曝光提醒你往高处走：把数字化记录工具用好，同时往康复治疗师方向考证升级——AI 拿走的只是文书，拿不走「带着患者站起来」的这门手艺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 康复方向需求确定、门槛适中，适合愿意服务他人、能吃苦的孩子。建议读康复治疗技术专业并尽早考证，把「助理→治疗师」的升级路径想清楚，别停在助理层。
立刻规划考证升级：助理转康复治疗师是收入翻倍的关键。同时学运动康复、神经康复等专科方向，用数字化随访工具提升服务半径。
有护理、体育、健身背景的人转型有优势。先补康复基础知识并考取助理相关证书，面试时突出「带过人训练、有耐心、身体好」的实际经验。
助理岗流动大，建议用「考证补贴 + 排班弹性 + 晋升通道」留人。给助理配数字化记录工具减负，把培训投入花在向治疗师升级的骨干身上。

ai_s7_trends: 老龄化与运动康复需求推动康复服务持续扩容。
数字化记录与远程康复普及，助理从文书转向纯服务。
「带练 + 专科 + 数字化」复合技能决定职业天花板。

body: 物理治疗助理与助手在物理治疗师的指导下执行康复训练方案，协助患者完成运动训练、器械使用与理疗操作，并做好记录、随访与日常照护，是康复服务链条中的执行与支持角。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can create storyboards and assets, but producers and directors still decide which scene moves the audience, how to coordinate the set, and how to reconcile schedules.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 167,000 producers and directors were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 175,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,200 jobs, with about 12,800 openings annually and median annual pay of about $83,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace producers and directors, but it will accelerate production. AI previsualization, editing, and generative assets speed up repetitive work, shifting directors from managing details toward creative judgment, set coordination, and overall control, while producers shift from monitoring workflows toward resource and distribution strategy. Routine execution roles face the greatest pressure, while people with creativity and coordination skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Creative judgment: people set the tone.
Set coordination: people organize people.
Quality control: people shape the final cut.
Resource coordination: people manage the budget.
Distribution coordination: people set the strategy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high exposure in production: systems accelerate storyboarding and editing, but creativity and coordination still leave a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: routine execution and editing tasks are replaced, not creative leadership roles. People who create ideas and lead teams become scarcer as efficiency rises. Those limited to routine execution face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in film, television, or media and gain full-process experience at school. Pure execution is shrinking in the AI era, so develop creativity and coordination early.
Advance from execution to creative development + project management, learn AI tools, and work toward producing independently.
Highlight your portfolio and coordination experience, and specify the project types you have worked on. Platforms value both reliability and drive.
Do not hire based only on reputation. Look for creative thinking. Lead creatives who deliver deserve a high profit share.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools increase efficiency, reducing execution work.
Streaming media creates growth.
People with creative coordination skills are in greater demand.

body: Producers and directors lead the creation and coordination of film, television, and other content. Directors oversee creative vision and the set, while producers oversee budgets and resources, using collaboration and postproduction to deliver finished work and coordinate distribution.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can create storyboards and assets, but producers and directors still decide which scene moves the audience, how to coordinate the set, and how to reconcile schedules.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能出分镜和素材，但哪场戏动人、现场怎么调度、档期怎么拧，还是导演和制片定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年制片人与导演在岗约 16.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.52 万人，净增约 0.82 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代制片导演，但会加速制作。AI 预演、剪辑与生成式素材把重复工作提速，导演从「盯琐碎」挪向「创意判断、现场调度、统筹把控」，制片从「盯流程」挪向「资源与发行策略」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规执行的人，有创意能统筹的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 创意判断：基调靠人定。
现场调度：人靠人排。
质量把控：成片靠人。
资源统筹：预算靠人。
发行对接：策略靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的制作区——分镜与剪辑被系统加速，但创意与统筹还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规执行与剪辑」动作，不是「创意统筹」的岗位。有创意力、能带团队的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做常规执行的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 影视/传媒本科打底，在校多摸全流程。AI 时代纯执行在缩，早点练创意和统筹。
从「执行」升级成「做创意 + 管项目」，学 AI 工具，争取独立做片。
突出作品和统筹经验，写清跟过哪些类型项目。平台看重稳和冲。
选人别只看名气，要看有没有创意脑子。能交付的主创，值得给高分成。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式提效，执行缩。
流媒体带来增量。
有创意统筹力的人更抢手。

body: 制片人与导演主导影视与内容的创作与统筹，导演主抓创意与现场，制片主抓预算与资源，运用协作与后期手段，交付成片并对接发行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能出分镜和素材，但哪场戏动人、现场怎么调度、档期怎么拧，还是导演和制片定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a polished career assessment report in ten minutes, but it cannot fully grasp the conflict behind a student saying, 'My parents want me to study finance, but the thought of finance frustrates me.'
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 376,300 school and career counselors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 389,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,300 jobs, with approximately 31,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $65,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace school and career counselors, but it will take over assessments, information organization, and plan generation. Real counseling depends on trust: students are willing to share what hurts most, and AI cannot provide that relationship.
ai_s2_accel: AI career assistants for rapid student-profile organization
Big-data employment outlook analysis to support recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Automated online reports for career and interest assessments
Rules-based recommendations for course and subject selection
AI search across education and employment information databases
ai_s3_list: Listening and empathy: recognizing the real concern behind 'I'm frustrated' is a fundamental counseling skill.
Crisis recognition and intervention: determine when a student's condition is concerning, how to respond, and when to refer the case.
Building trust: students speak honestly when you protect confidentiality and create safety.
Family-school coordination: help anxious parents and resistant students hear each other.
Career insight: translate real-world occupational information into language students understand.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 reflects the occupation's substantial assessment, recordkeeping, and information-management workload, which AI and software increasingly handle. Face-to-face listening, crisis intervention, and relationship-building remain core human advantages.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI can assemble assessment reports and career data, but students will not cry in front of AI. Transactional counseling that only distributes assessments and recites data faces pressure, while counselors skilled in deep listening and crisis intervention become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To enter the field, study psychology, education, or social work, complete internships, and pursue relevant counseling credentials during your bachelor's program. In the AI era, master assessment tools while developing deep-listening skills, the real capability beyond certificates.

Let AI tools handle assessments and records, and give the saved time to students. Advance toward crisis intervention and career-planning credentials, and build case experience. Within school systems, counseling qualifications are a firm promotion threshold.

A background in education or psychology provides the fastest transition. Earn credentials before entering a school, starting as a counseling intern or student advisor. A resume stating 'XX counseling sessions completed and XX types of crisis cases handled' is more useful than general claims of passion.

Prioritize credentials and supervision experience when hiring counselors. One crisis-case scenario can reveal a candidate's skill. Adequate supervision and referral resources substantially reduce burnout and improve retention.

ai_s7_trends: Assessment and information organization are becoming fully AI-enabled, allowing counselors to devote time to deep one-on-one counseling and crisis intervention.
Greater attention to student mental health is creating a shortage of counselors with crisis-intervention skills.
Credential requirements for career planners and school psychology teachers are tightening, making certification a firm threshold for entry and advancement.

body: School and Career Counselors and Advisors provide academic, psychological, educational, and career-development counseling to students in primary and secondary schools, vocational schools, and universities. Their work includes course selection, career planning, psychological support, crisis intervention, and family-school communication.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate a polished career assessment report in ten minutes, but it cannot fully grasp the conflict behind a student saying, 'My parents want me to study finance, but the thought of finance frustrates me.'

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能十分钟生成一份漂亮的职业测评报告，但学生说「我爸妈让我学金融，可我一想到金融就烦」，这句话背后的纠结，AI 接不住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年学校与职业咨询顾问在岗约 37.63 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.96 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.51 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学校与职业咨询顾问，但会接管测评、信息整理和方案生成。真正的咨询靠的是信任关系——学生愿意把最难受的事告诉你，这是 AI 给不了的。
ai_s2_accel: AI 生涯助手辅助整理学生画像
大数据就业前景分析支撑建议
在线心理健康筛查工具
智能排课与个案提醒系统
ai_s2_auto: 职业与兴趣测评在线自动生成报告
选科选课方案按规则自动推荐
升学就业信息库 AI 检索
咨询档案与记录数字化
ai_s3_list: 倾听与共情：把「我烦」背后的真实困扰听出来，是咨询的基本功。
危机识别与干预：学生状态不对时，怎么判断、怎么转介、怎么处理。
信任关系建立：学生愿意说真话，靠的是你守得住秘密、给得了安全感。
家校协调：家长焦虑、学生对抗时，怎么让两边都听得进话。
职业洞察：把真实世界的职业信息翻译成学生听得懂的语言。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的测评、档案、信息整理比重不低，这些正被 AI 与软件接管；但面对面的倾听、危机干预与关系建立，是人的核心壁垒。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 帮你把测评报告、职业数据「配齐」，但学生不会对 AI 掉眼泪。真正被挤压的是「只发测评、只念数据」的事务型咨询；会深度倾听、懂危机干预的顾问反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入这行，选心理学、教育学或社会工作，本科期间多做实习、考心理咨询相关证书。AI 时代把「测评工具」学透的同时，更要练深度倾听——这是证书之外的真本事。
把测评和档案交给 AI 工具，把省下的时间留给学生。往危机干预、生涯规划师认证方向升级，多积累个案；学校体系内，心理咨询资质是晋升的硬门槛。
有教育学或心理学背景转这行最快。先考证再入校，从实习咨询师或辅导员做起。简历写「累计咨询XX人次、处理过XX类危机个案」，比空谈热爱有用。
招顾问优先看资质与督导经历，考一个危机案例的处理思路就能看出水平。给咨询师配足督导和转介资源，能显著降低职业倦怠与留人难度。

ai_s7_trends: 测评与信息整理全面 AI 化，顾问把时间留给一对一深度咨询与危机干预。
学生心理健康受重视程度上升，具备危机干预能力的顾问紧缺。
「生涯规划师」「心理教师」资质要求趋严，持证成为入行与晋升硬门槛。

body: 学校与职业咨询顾问在中小学、职业院校和高校为学生提供学业、心理、升学与职业发展方面的咨询辅导，包括选科选课、生涯规划、心理支持、危机干预与家校沟通。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能十分钟生成一份漂亮的职业测评报告，但学生说「我爸妈让我学金融，可我一想到金融就烦」，这句话背后的纠结，AI 接不住。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule production automatically and robots can tighten screws, but team assemblers still provide the techniques needed during model changes and the judgment to respond when the line jams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 1,467,100 team assemblers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,465,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,200 jobs, with approximately 156,300 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $42,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace team assemblers, but it will change workstation structures. Automated scheduling, robotic assembly, and intelligent inspection are spreading, with robots taking over simple repetitive stations. People are still needed for multi-process operations, exception handling, and teamwork. Assemblers who understand equipment and adapt to change become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automated production scheduling and work-order issuance
Automated parts delivery to the line
ai_s3_list: Multi-process proficiency: People can switch and cover workstations, which machines cannot replace.
Exception handling: People respond immediately to shortages, jams, and parts that will not fit.
Quality judgment: People detect incorrect feel or mismatched dimensions immediately.
Teamwork: People cover positions and coach coworkers.
Equipment and human-machine collaboration: Working with robotic arms defines future workstations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means repetitive workstations are being automated. Robotic assembly and intelligent inspection take over simple processes, but people retain multi-process work and adaptability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still brings change. Single-process repetitive roles face the greatest impact, while assemblers who know multiple processes, cover other stations, and collaborate with equipment are in greater demand. The job shifts from operation toward collaboration + adaptability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For those not pursuing university, vocational programs in mechatronics or intelligent manufacturing offer stronger prospects and routes into technical roles on automated lines. Do not practice only one operation; learn equipment principles.

Learn multiple processes and product models, and earn electrical or equipment-operation credentials. Move toward line leader, quality inspection, or equipment maintenance to avoid a single repetitive station.

Factory entry barriers are low. Start as an assembler to learn the line, then transition into technical roles. On your resume, specify the processes you know, stations you have covered, and equipment you understand.
Do not recruit solely for speed. Evaluate learning ability and reliability. Automated lines most need versatile workers who adapt to model changes and collaborate with equipment.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Work orders, cycle time, and quality tracking
Automatic parts delivery to the line

ai_s7_trends: Robotic assembly and human-machine collaboration spread, reducing single-process repetitive roles and shifting assemblers toward multiple processes + equipment collaboration.
Flexible production and rapid changeovers become mainstream, increasing demand for versatile workers who adapt to multiple models.
Intelligent inspection and data dashboards spread, concentrating assembler value around adaptability and quality control.

body: Team assemblers assemble and inspect product components according to standard processes on manufacturing lines. They load materials, assemble and fasten parts, connect wiring, and perform visual inspections, coordinating with team members to meet cycle-time and quality standards.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动排产、机器人能拧螺丝，但换机型时的那套手法、线体卡壳时的应变，还得靠装配工的手和脑子。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年团队装配工在岗约 146.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 146.59 万人，岗位净减约 0.12 万个，年均产生约 15.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.22 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代团队装配工，但会改变工位结构。自动排产、机器人装配、智能质检正普及，简单重复的工位被机器人接管；但多工序操作、异常应变和团队协作仍需人，会设备、能适应变化的装配工反而更有价值。
ai_s3_list: 多工序的操作熟练度：会换位、能顶岗，机器替代不了。
异常应变：缺料、卡料、装不进去，当场处理靠人。
质量的判断：手感不对、尺寸不合，第一时间发现。
团队协作：补位、传帮带，配合靠人。
设备与人机协作：会跟机械臂配合，是未来工位的样子。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的重复工位正被自动化——机器人装配、智能质检在接管简单工序，但多工序和应变能力还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。纯单工序重复岗受冲击最大，但会多工序、能顶岗、会跟设备协作的装配工更抢手，岗位从「操作」转向「协作+应变」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想走大学路的话，技校机电一体化、智能制造专业更有前途，毕业进自动化产线做技术岗。别只练单一操作，多学设备原理。
多学几道工序和机型，考电工或设备操作证书。往线长、质检、设备维护方向走，避开单一重复工位。
进厂门槛低，先做装配工熟悉产线，再往技术岗转。简历上多写「会哪些工序、顶过哪些岗、熟悉什么设备」。
招人别只看手脚快，要看学习能力和稳定性。自动化产线最缺的是能适应换型、会跟设备协作的多面手。

ai_s7_trends: 机器人装配与人机协作普及，单工序重复岗收缩，装配工转向「多工序+设备协作」。
柔性生产与快速换型成为主流，能适应多机型的多面手更抢手。
智能质检与数据看板普及，装配工的岗位价值向「应变与质量把关」集中。

body: 团队装配工在制造生产线上按标准工序完成产品零部件的组装与检测，负责上料、装配、紧固、接线、目检等工作，与团队成员配合达到生产节拍和质量标准。
